questions.question_text: 1) Accountability - Accepts responsibility for actions and their consequences.
2) Punctuality & Attendance - Is rarely absent, arrives punctually, works required hours.
3) Cooperation - Has ability to get along with coworkers and supervisors.
4) Attitude/Respectfulness - Shows initiative, optimism, and politeness.
5) Accepts Criticism - Has ability to learn from suggestions and change behavior.
6) Flexibility - Has capacity to respond to changing situations and expectations.
7) Policy & Procedures - Follows organization's policies and procedures.
8) Completion of Assignments - Successfully completes tasks and meets all deadlines.
9) Client Interaction - Ensures high-quality care, respects client's dignity and confidentiality.
10) Quality of Work - Is excellent, thorough, and completed.
11) Willingness to Develop Skills - Desires to take on challenges & develop their skill set.
12) Communication Skills - Conveys information effectively and efficiently.
13) Organizational Skills - Has capacity to stay on track and use time effectively.
14) Confidentiality - Does not discuss internal events with coworkers.
15) Appearance/Dress Code - Demonstrates a professional and well-kept appearance.
16) Equipment - Keeps all equipment cleaned, operating correctly, and organized.
17) Problem Resolution - Takes constructive approaches to resolving workplace issues.
18) Safety - Contributes to a safe and secure environments by following established procedures.
19) Job Knowledge - Demonstrates working knowledge of procedures and policies with minimal assistance from other supervisors.
20) Resourceful - Has the ability to use supervisors for resources to execute services.
21) Inventory - Has ability to keep a well-recorded stock of items used and needed.
22) Availability - Is available to work any shifts as needed by GermBlast.
23) Computer Skills - Effectively navigates all computer programs necessary to complete tasks.
24) Telephone Manners - Sounds professional & successfully uses scripts/techniques.
25) Client Flow - Has ability to keep clients scheduled services on time.
26) ATP - Has capacity to take, read, and record ATP in a timely manner.
27) Service Organization - Keeps up with reports in MATRIX.
28) Service Plan - Has ability to properly plan for successful service in Matrix.
29) Skills and Duties - Has mastery of skills and daily maintenance without supervision of Supervisor.
30) Service Preparation - Prepares for Services utilizing other supervisors and resources.
31) Client Interaction - Performs service with excellence and speaks to clients with professionalism.
32) Service Procedures - Provides pre and post service notes in Matrix to ensure the client experience when required is the utmost importance.
33) Matrix Information - Completes services with accuracy & urgency, does not need direction from Lead Supervisor.
